subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should OpenClaw accept a persistent delivery-mirror transcript row as the WebChat restart-recovery notice contract after rebasing this PR onto current main?
rationale: The code path is a plausible fix, but it intentionally changes persisted transcript history and currently conflicts with newer transcript helper behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve the newer transcript helper behavior, and land the guarded transcript fallback as the WebChat notice contract.

options.title: Request Live WebChat Proof
options.body: Ask for a short Control UI restart/reconnect proof before accepting the persisted notice behavior.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, request preservation, or SQLite recovery-route work to define the durable contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve the newer transcript helper behavior, and land the guarded transcript fallback as the WebChat notice contract.
